projects.name: NYSDOT Capital Program Projects - Project Points (Planned/Development)
projects.notes: NYSDOT 'Projects in Your Neighborhood' capital program. Service has three point layers split by stage (per layer renderer labels): 0 = Planned/Development, 1 = In Construction, 2 = Construction Complete; layers 3/4/5 are the matching polygons. Use layer 0 (and 3) for planned work. No cost, name or letting date fields: only PIN, PublicFriendlyDescription, WORK_CATEGORY, ConstructionCompleteDate (estimated completion), LettingOrganization, ResponsibleOrganization, and WEPIURL linking to the project detail page (which shows cost/letting). Point layers draw only when zoomed in but query fine.

projects.name: NYSDOT Capital Program Projects - Project Polygons (Planned/Development)
projects.notes: Polygon footprint (buffered project limits) version of layer 0, same attributes and same record set. Better than points for intersecting parcels.

projects.name: NYSDOT Capital Program Projects - Project Points (In Construction)
projects.notes: Same schema, projects already in construction (not planned). Listed so they can be excluded/distinguished; layer 4 is the polygon version.

parcels_statewide.name: NYS Tax Parcels Public (NYS ITS Geospatial Services, 2025 roll)
parcels_statewide.restrictions: Item licence is a warranty/liability disclaimer only ('This map service is available to the public'); no commercial-use or solicitation restriction stated on the service.
parcels_statewide.notes: Owner name and mailing address present (3,810,140 of 3,827,530 rows have PRIMARY_OWNER). NOT fully statewide: only the 38 counties that agreed to public sharing, including all five NYC boroughs (Bronx, Kings, NewYork, Queens, Richmond), Suffolk, Westchester, Erie, Onondaga, Albany, Orange, Rockland; missing e.g. Nassau, Monroe, Dutchess, Saratoga, Niagara. ADD_OWNER is the second owner; SWIS_SBL_ID is a statewide-unique id (SWIS + SBL); layer 0 of the service is the coverage footprint. Updated annually. The older gisservices.its.ny.gov MapServer URL answered 'service not started' on the check date.
parcels_statewide.approved_note: Approved by the account owner on 2026-11-17: no restriction on commercial use stated.

summary: NYSDOT capital-program layers separate Planned/Development from In Construction (thin attributes, no cost). NYS Tax Parcels Public has owner name and mailing address but covers only 38 of 62 counties (includes NYC, Suffolk, Westchester, Erie; not Nassau or Monroe).
